items.title: AI模型在这些智力测试中失败，你能做得更好吗？
items.originalTitle: AI models flub these intelligence tests. Can you fare any better?
items.summary: 谜题和游戏自始至终是AI发展的核心。正如人类喜欢用填字游戏或逻辑谜题测试智商，开发者可通过游戏挑战测试模型进步程度。“机器学习”一词在1959年由IBM计算机科学家Arthur…普及。
keyFacts: games have been central to AI development since the very beginning
Just as we humans like to test our smarts with crosswords or logic puzzles
developers can test how far models have advanced with a gaming gauntlet
